models.description: Cold-start decision model. Deterministic evidence fusion with magnitude-aware margins, one vote per metric family, declared database priors, class distance where statistics exist, and hierarchical family-before-material resolution. No trained classifier: with one verified observation per material there is nothing a supervised model could be validated against.

provenance.note: Every number in this model is a declared engineering judgement, not a fitted parameter. Nothing here was tuned against the twelve observations of 2026-08-17 - they are validation cases, and tuning against them would make the validation meaningless.
